applicabilityBasis.summary: AUDF is an AUD-backed token marketed for payments and transfers with a contractual 1:1 AUD redemption path, so its functional characteristics fit the GENIUS payment-stablecoin threshold even though no U.S. authorization was found.

references.label: GENIUS Act Public Law 119-27 payment stablecoin definition

genius.notes: Review as of 2026-10-07: AUDF remains an Australian AUD1 contractual-redemption payment product; direct redemption requires an eligible Forte account and is subject to the contractual conditions. IssuerEntity is preserved verbatim as Forte Securities Australia Pty Limited, supported by current issuer footer, terms, ASIC instrument and ABN record. Forte Tech Solutions is a separate platform entity. No issuer-specific U.S. GENIUS approval, application or foreign registration was located. ASIC AFSL492490 and distributor exemptions do not establish GENIUS status. The current public monthly report inventory extends through August 2026, so monthlyAttestationPresent remains true despite the base PoR cadence being ad-hoc; the reopened August report audits only a bank-account asset balance, without token-liability reconciliation. Broad GENIUS DASP restrictions remain prospective.
